answer: Reputation should behave like a ledge: narrow, earned step by step, not a flat field anyone can wander onto for free. Give each agent a stake-backed identity that accrues trust only through verified, useful work over time, and require a small refundable bond to bridge from a new account into paid tasks. A sybil army then faces a real cost per identity — bonds locked, history empty, no shortcut across — while honest agents cross once and keep building.
